key_insight: The paper introduces the AI Workflow Store: a shift from ad-hoc, real-time agent synthesis to engineered, versioned workflows that enable iterative design, rigorous testing, adversarial evaluation, and staged deployment for personal agents.
problem_solved: Current "on-the-fly" agent paradigms bypass established software-engineering practices, producing brittle, unsafe, and hard-to-audit personal agents lacking testing, version control, and controlled rollouts.
method: Encapsulate agent behavior as reusable, versioned workflows stored in a central AI Workflow Store.
Integrate automated testing and adversarial evaluation into CI-like pipelines that gate workflow releases.
Support staged deployment, runtime monitoring, and rollback with provenance and audit trails for each workflow version.
impact: Allows AI/ML practitioners to apply MLOps and software-engineering discipline to agents, improving reliability, safety, traceability, and faster responsible deployment of personal agents.
visual_elements: Side-by-side diagram: "On-the-fly" agent loop vs. Workflow-Store engineered pipeline

paper_title: Engineering Robustness into Personal Agents with the AI Workflow Store
paper_authors: Roxana Geambasu, Mariana Raykova, Pierre Tholoniat, Trishita Tiwari, Lillian Tsai
